title: Modules by UI stack
note: Each UI module counts once. The scanner looks for Kotlin files containing @Composable and XML layout resources.

title: Compose share of UI source files
note: Each Kotlin file containing @Composable and each XML layout in src/main counts once. A file can contain several composables.

title: Design system use and remaining work
note: Share of recognized component calls across scanned Android screens. Repeated uses count separately. The denominator excludes system controls.

title: Android component catalog
note: Each catalog component applicable to Android counts once. Availability measures how much of the catalog the team has implemented.

title: MVP and MVVM in the migration scan
note: Share of presenter and BaseViewModel files matched by inheritance in app and context. Each percentage uses the combined count for that day.

title: BaseViewModel files matched by the scanner
note: Counts Kotlin files in app and context with a constructor followed by direct BaseViewModel inheritance, including new features. Direct AndroidX subclasses such as AuthContainerViewModel, declarations without that constructor pattern and indirect subclasses fall outside this count. Gaps mark missing observations.

title: Unit tests
note: Percentage of bytecode instructions covered by unit tests in nightly JaCoCo reports.

title: UI tests
note: Percentage of bytecode instructions covered by UI tests in nightly JaCoCo reports.

title: Screenshot coverage of UI modules
note: A UI module has Compose code or XML layouts. A module counts as covered when it contains at least one checked-in golden PNG. This measures module reach.

title: Screenshot baselines
note: tracked golden PNG images under src/screenshotTestDebug/reference; one test may have several images

title: Tests by module
note: Share of all unit tests or golden images in the latest snapshot. The smallest modules are grouped under Other.

title: Detekt baseline
note: entries excluded from normal detekt checks by the checked-in baseline

title: Modules
note: Gradle project paths included in settings.gradle, excluding the wiki
